title: Reject calendar dates that JavaScript normalises

startingState.description: A synthetic persisted-date parser accepts impossible dates because Date normalises them, and its tests cover only syntax.

prompt: Fix the persisted-date regression in toolkits/agent-evaluation/cases/regression-date-validation/workspace. parseDate must accept a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date and return its canonical string, while rejecting malformed or impossible dates without timezone-dependent behaviour. Add regression coverage for the original impossible-date defect and a leap-year boundary. Keep changes inside the allowed workspace.
expectedObservableResult: Impossible calendar dates are rejected rather than normalised.
Leap-year boundaries have explicit regression coverage.
The focused test suite passes without timezone dependence.
